Integrating Your Templates with Teeinblue ​

Once your template is ready, hook it into Teeinblue from the Artwork Editor.

  1. In the Teeinblue Artwork Editor, create a new Photo Upload Layer.

  2. Under the Gen AI Effect section, select [ImagenHub] AI Effect.

  3. You'll see the list of all templates you've created.

That's it — your setup is complete.

You now have full control over your AI generation workflows. Each Photo Upload Layer in your products can be assigned a different template, allowing you to use specific models and prompts independently for every design. You're no longer restricted to a single model store-wide; mix, match, and manage your AI configurations exactly as needed.
